title: Beef & Mushroom Shepherd's Pie
ingredients:
24 oz potatoes
1.5 tbsp sour cream
0.5 cup white cheddar cheese
8 oz button mushrooms
6 oz carrots
1 onion
0.25 oz thyme
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tbsp flour
1 tomato paste
3 veggie stock concentrate
10 oz ground beef
2 tsp olive oil
3 tbsp butter
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Boil diced potatoes until tender (15-20 min), reserve 1/2 cup liquid.
2. Brown ground beef, set aside; prep mushrooms, carrots, onion, thyme.
3. Saute mushrooms until browned, add carrots and onion until softened.
4. Add butter, thyme, garlic powder, flour, tomato paste; stir in water and stock; simmer to thicken; return beef.
5. Mash potatoes with sour cream, half the cheese, butter.
6. Broil: spread potatoes over filling, top with cheese, broil 3-4 min; rest 5 min.

title: Korean Beef Bibimbap
ingredients:
1 zucchini
4 oz button mushrooms
2 scallions
6 oz carrots
1 thumb ginger
2 cloves garlic
3/4 cup jasmine rice
5 tsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp sesame oil
2 tsp sriracha
3 tbsp soy sauce
10 oz ground beef
1.5 tbsp sugar
4 tsp vegetable oil
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Boil water; slice zucchini, mushrooms, scallions; shave carrot; mince ginger and garlic.
2. Cook rice covered 15-20 min.
3. Pickle scallion whites in vinegar+salt; mix sauce (sesame oil, sugar, sriracha, soy).
4. Cook carrot, then zucchini, then mushrooms separately; set aside.
5. Cook garlic+ginger, add beef until browned, add soy until evaporated.
6. Divide rice, arrange beef and veg, drizzle sauce, top with scallion greens.

title: Sesame Beef Tacos
ingredients:
24 radishes
1 Persian cucumber
2 scallions
1/4 oz cilantro
5 tsp white wine vinegar
4 tbsp sour cream
1 tsp Korean chili flakes
4 oz shredded red cabbage
10 oz ground beef
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tbsp sesame oil
2 tsp sriracha
2 tbsp soy sauce
6 flour tortillas
1 tsp vegetable oil
2.5 tsp sugar
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Slice radishes and cucumber; slice scallions; pick cilantro.
2. Pickle radish+cucumber in vinegar, sugar, salt.
3. Mix sour cream with chili flakes.
4. Cook scallions+cabbage, add beef+garlic powder+sugar until browned; stir in sesame oil, sriracha, soy.
5. Warm tortillas.
6. Spread crema, add filling, pickled veg, cilantro, sriracha.

title: Sesame Kimchi Fried Rice
ingredients:
2 tbsp vegetarian oyster sauce
10 oz chopped chicken breast
1 onion
4 oz peas
1 tbsp sweet soy glaze
4 oz red cabbage & carrot mix
1 tbsp sesame seeds
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 kimchi
2 scallions
1 tsp garlic powder
3/4 cup white rice
1 oz gochujang sauce
4 tsp cooking oil
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Cook rice covered 15-18 min.
2. Dice onion, slice scallions.
3. Saute onion, scallion whites, cabbage mix; mix gochujang with garlic powder, sesame oil, oyster sauce, soy glaze.
4. Cook kimchi, add rice and crisp 2-3 min.
5. Add veg, peas, sauce; press 2-3 min; optional fried egg.
6. Garnish with sesame seeds, scallion greens, soy glaze.

title: Moo Shu Pork Bowls
ingredients:
2 scallions
1 lime
10 oz ground pork
4 oz shredded red cabbage
2 tbsp hoisin sauce
1 oz sweet Thai chili sauce
4 tbsp sweet soy glaze
3/4 cup jasmine rice
1 tbsp sesame seeds
salt, pepper, oil, sugar, butter
steps:
1. Cook rice 15-18 min; slice scallions; quarter lime.
2. Brown pork 4-6 min, drain excess.
3. Add scallion whites+cabbage 2-3 min; add hoisin, chili sauce, soy glaze, sugar; season with lime.
4. Stir butter into rice; top with pork; garnish scallion greens, sesame seeds.

title: Beef & Zucchini Bibimbap
ingredients:
6 oz carrot
1 zucchini
2 tbsp soy sauce
5 tsp white wine vinegar
1 clove garlic
1 tbsp sesame oil
10 oz ground beef
2 scallions
3/4 cup jasmine rice
2 tsp sriracha
1 thumb ginger
1 tbsp cooking oil
1 tbsp sugar
steps:
1. Cook rice 15-18 min.
2. Slice scallions, shave carrots, slice zucchini, mince ginger+garlic.
3. Pickle scallion whites; make sauce (sesame oil, soy, sugar, sriracha).
4. Cook carrots 3-4 min; cook zucchini; set aside.
5. Cook beef with ginger+garlic 4-6 min; add soy.
6. Serve rice topped with beef, veg, pickles, sauce.

title: Pork & Veggie Bibimbap
ingredients:
3/4 cup jasmine rice
2 scallions
6 oz carrots
1 zucchini
1 thumb ginger
1 clove garlic
5 tsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp sesame oil
2 tsp sriracha
2 tbsp soy sauce
10 oz ground pork
1 tbsp sugar
1 tbsp cooking oil
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Cook rice 15-18 min.
2. Slice scallions, shave carrots, slice zucchini, mince ginger+garlic.
3. Pickle scallion whites; make sauce (sesame oil, soy, sugar, sriracha).
4. Cook carrots 3-4 min; cook zucchini; set aside.
5. Cook pork with ginger+garlic 4-6 min; add soy.
6. Serve rice topped with pork, veg, pickles, sauce, scallion greens.

title: Sausage Rigatoni Rosa
ingredients:
6 oz rigatoni
1 zucchini
1 clove garlic
9 oz pork sausage
1.5 oz tomato paste
4 tbsp cream cheese
1 chicken stock concentrate
1 tsp chili flakes
0.5 cup Parmesan
2 tsp cooking oil
0.5 tsp sugar
1 tbsp butter
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Cook rigatoni 9-11 min; reserve 1 cup pasta water. Slice zucchini; mince garlic.
2. Cook zucchini 5-6 min, remove. Brown sausage 3-4 min.
3. Add garlic+tomato paste 1-2 min; stir in cream cheese, stock, pasta water, butter, sugar, chili flakes.
4. Combine pasta+zucchini with sauce; mix in half Parmesan; top with rest.

title: Chicken Sausage Rigatoni
ingredients:
1 bell pepper
9 oz Italian chicken sausage mix
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
4 oz cream sauce base
2 scallions
6 oz rigatoni
1.5 oz tomato paste
1/4 cup Parmesan
1 tsp olive oil
1 tsp sugar
1 tbsp butter
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Dice bell pepper; slice scallions.
2. Cook bell pepper 3-4 min; add sausage+scallion whites 4-6 min.
3. Cook rigatoni 9-11 min; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
4. Stir in Italian seasoning, tomato paste, sugar, water; simmer.
5. Add cream sauce base and butter; season.
6. Toss pasta; top with Parmesan and scallion greens.

title: Triple Mushroom Truffle Penne
ingredients:
8 oz button mushrooms
2 scallions
1 tomato
1/4 cup panko
1 tsp garlic powder
1 mushroom stock concentrate
4 tbsp cream cheese
3 tbsp Parmesan
2 g truffle zest
6 oz penne
2 tsp olive oil
3 tbsp butter
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Boil salted water; prep produce.
2. Toast panko in butter with garlic powder; set aside.
3. Cook penne until al dente; drain.
4. Brown mushrooms in oil+salt.
5. Make sauce with scallions, garlic, stock, cream cheese, Parmesan, truffle zest.
6. Combine pasta with sauce; top with panko, greens, cheese.

title: Creamy Mushroom Cavatappi
ingredients:
1/4 cup Parmesan
6 oz cavatappi
2 tbsp cream cheese
1 cup milk
8 oz cremini mushrooms
2 tbsp garlic herb butter
2 scallions
1 tbsp flour
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Boil water; slice mushrooms and scallions.
2. Cook mushrooms 5-7 min, transfer out.
3. Cook cavatappi 9-11 min; reserve 1 cup pasta water.
4. Melt butter, add scallion whites 1 min, flour 1-2 min; whisk in milk+pasta water, simmer 3-4 min.
5. Stir in cream cheese; add mushrooms, pasta, garlic herb butter.
6. Top with Parmesan and scallion greens.

title: Rigatoni with Beef & Zucchini Ragu
ingredients:
6 oz rigatoni
1/4 cup Parmesan
1 tomato paste
1 zucchini
10 oz ground beef
4 tbsp cream cheese
1 clove garlic
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 beef stock concentrate
1 shallot
1 tsp cooking oil
1/2 tsp sugar
1 tbsp butter
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Cook rigatoni 9-11 min; reserve 1 cup pasta water. Dice shallot, mince garlic, grate+squeeze zucchini.
2. Cook beef, shallot, Italian seasoning 3-5 min.
3. Add tomato paste 1-2 min; add zucchini, garlic 2-3 min; add cream cheese, stock, pasta water, sugar; simmer.
4. Stir in rigatoni, half Parmesan, butter; top with rest.

title: Beef Bulgogi Tacos & Bibimbap
ingredients:
2 scallions
1 thumb ginger
1 lime
4 oz shredded carrots
5 tsp white wine vinegar
3/4 cup jasmine rice
20 oz ground beef
8 oz bulgogi sauce
8 oz shredded red cabbage
4 tbsp sour cream
3 tsp sriracha
6 flour tortillas
2 tsp sugar
1 tbsp vegetable oil
1 tbsp butter
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Pickle carrots in vinegar, sugar, salt.
2. Cook rice with scallion whites+ginger 15-20 min.
3. Saute cabbage 3-4 min.
4. Brown beef; add bulgogi sauce and cabbage; simmer.
5. Mix sriracha crema; warm tortillas; assemble tacos with beef, pickled carrots, crema.
6. Serve extra beef over rice for a bibimbap lunch.

title: Japanese-Inspired Beef Tan Tan Men
ingredients:
20 oz ground beef
2 tbsp soy sauce
4 oz bok choy & napa cabbage
2 tbsp Szechuan paste
1 tbsp sesame seeds
6 oz udon noodles
1 peanut butter
2 scallions
1 tsp sriracha
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tbsp cooking oil
salt, pepper, sugar
steps:
1. Slice scallions.
2. Cook scallion whites+veg 3-5 min, remove.
3. Brown beef 4-6 min, season, remove.
4. Add Szechuan paste, sriracha, peanut butter, half soy, 3 cups water, sugar; simmer 2-4 min.
5. Boil broth, add udon 1-2 min.
6. Divide broth+noodles; top with veg, beef, scallion greens, sesame.

title: Japanese Panko Chicken
ingredients:
1 thumb ginger
2 scallions
1/2 cup jasmine rice
6 oz green beans
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 tbsp sesame seeds
10 oz chicken cutlets
2 tbsp sour cream
1/2 cup panko
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 oz ketchup
2 tsp soy sauce
4 tsp vegetable oil
1 tsp sugar
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Oven 425F. Mince ginger; slice scallions.
2. Cook rice with ginger+scallion whites ~15 min.
3. Roast green beans 10-12 min; toss with sesame oil+seeds.
4. Brush chicken with sour cream, press into seasoned panko.
5. Pan-fry chicken 3-4 min/side. Mix sauce (ketchup, Dijon, soy, sugar, water).
6. Slice chicken over rice; drizzle sauce; top with scallion greens.

title: Street Cart-Style Chicken Bowls
ingredients:
1 tsp turmeric
1/2 cup jasmine rice
1 chicken stock concentrate
2 scallions
1 lemon
1 tomato
1.5 tbsp sour cream
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tsp garlic powder
10 oz diced chicken thighs
1 tbsp shawarma spice
2 whole wheat pitas
1 tsp hot sauce
1 tsp cooking oil
3 tbsp butter
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Melt butter with turmeric, add rice+water+stock; simmer 15-18 min.
2. Quarter lemon, slice scallions, dice tomato.
3. Mix white sauce (sour cream, mayo, garlic powder, lemon, water).
4. Season chicken with shawarma; cook with scallion whites 4-6 min.
5. Toast buttered pitas, cut into quarters.
6. Bowl rice, chicken, tomato; drizzle sauces; garnish.

title: Sesame Soy Beef Bowls
ingredients:
4 scallions
4 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tsp sriracha
2 tbsp sesame oil
8 oz shredded carrots
20 oz ground beef
8 tbsp sweet soy glaze
5 tsp white wine vinegar
1.5 cup jasmine rice
1 tsp vegetable oil
2 tbsp butter
salt, sugar, pepper
steps:
1. Cook rice 15-18 min. Slice scallions; mix sriracha mayo.
2. Cook carrots+scallion whites 1-2 min; season; remove.
3. Brown beef 3-5 min, drain; add soy glaze, vinegar, sesame oil; simmer 2-3 min.
4. Butter rice; bowl rice, carrots, beef; drizzle sriracha mayo, scallion greens.

title: Tex-Mex Pork Enchilada Bowls
ingredients:
1 red onion
4 tbsp sour cream
1/2 cup jasmine rice
1/2 cup pepper jack cheese
1 long green pepper
10 oz ground pork
1 tomato
1 lime
1 tbsp Tex-Mex paste
1 tbsp Southwest spice blend
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Slice onion (mince some for salsa), slice green pepper, dice tomato, zest+quarter lime.
2. Cook rice 15-18 min.
3. Make salsa (tomato, onion, lime); make crema (sour cream, spice).
4. Cook green pepper then onion until browned; season.
5. Brown pork, add Tex-Mex paste+spice+water; simmer.
6. Bowl rice; top with pork, veg, cheese, salsa, crema.

title: Beef Bulgogi Bowls
ingredients:
1/2 cup jasmine rice
2 scallions
5 tsp white wine vinegar
1 cucumber
4 oz shredded carrots
10 oz ground beef
1 tbsp sesame seeds
4 oz bulgogi sauce
4 tbsp sour cream
1 tsp sriracha
1/2 tsp sugar
2 tsp vegetable oil
1 tbsp butter
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Cook rice 15-18 min. Slice scallions.
2. Pickle cucumber ribbons in vinegar, sugar, salt.
3. Cook carrots 1 min; season.
4. Cook scallion whites, add beef until browned 4-6 min; stir in sesame, vinegar, bulgogi sauce.
5. Mix sriracha crema.
6. Butter rice; bowl rice, beef, carrots, cucumber; drizzle crema, sesame, scallion greens.

title: Indian-Style Butter Chicken & Rice
ingredients:
20 oz diced dark meat chicken
1.5 cup jasmine rice
2 naan
1 oz Vidalia onion paste
2 tomato paste
2 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp curry powder
2 tsp garlic powder
4 oz cream sauce base
2 chicken stock concentrate
2 veggie stock concentrate
4 tbsp yogurt
1/2 cup mozzarella
1/4 oz cilantro
5 tbsp butter
2 tsp cooking oil
1/2 tsp sugar
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Cook rice 15-18 min.
2. Make garlic butter; chop cilantro.
3. Brown chicken 6-8 min.
4. Add spices, tomato paste, onion paste, stock; stir in cream base+water; simmer; finish with butter+sugar.
5. Broil naan with garlic butter+mozzarella 3-4 min.
6. Bowl rice+butter chicken; drizzle yogurt, cilantro; serve with naan.

title: Chinese Spicy Kung Pao-Style Chicken
ingredients:
3/4 cup jasmine rice
1 bell pepper
2 scallions
4 tbsp sweet soy glaze
5 tsp rice wine vinegar
2 tbsp Szechuan paste
1/2 oz peanuts
10 oz diced chicken thighs
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tsp chili flakes
2 tsp cooking oil
1 tsp sugar
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Cook rice 15-18 min.
2. Prep veg; whisk sauce (soy glaze, vinegar, Szechuan paste, water, sugar).
3. Toast peanuts; saute bell pepper+scallion whites.
4. Brown chicken with garlic powder.
5. Return veg, add sauce, thicken with cornstarch slurry.
6. Serve over rice; top with peanuts, scallion greens, chili flakes.

title: Sweet Chili Chicken Bowls
ingredients:
1 bell pepper
1 yellow onion
1 lime
1/4 oz cilantro
3/4 cup jasmine rice
1/2 oz peanuts
10 oz diced chicken thighs
4 tbsp sweet soy glaze
1 oz sweet Thai chili sauce
1 tsp sugar
1 tbsp cooking oil
2 tbsp butter
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Slice bell pepper+onion; zest+quarter lime; chop cilantro.
2. Cook rice 15-18 min.
3. Candy peanuts with water+sugar 3-5 min.
4. Cook bell pepper+onion 6-9 min; set aside.
5. Cook chicken 4-6 min; add veg, soy glaze, chili sauce, butter.
6. Butter+lime rice; bowl rice, chicken, peanuts, cilantro.

title: Chicken Sausage Cavatappi Bolognese
ingredients:
1 yellow onion
1 zucchini
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
6 oz cavatappi
9 oz Italian chicken sausage mix
1.5 oz tomato paste
1 chicken stock concentrate
2 tbsp sour cream
1/4 cup Parmesan
2 tsp cooking oil
1 tbsp butter
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Oven 450F. Halve zucchini; slice onion.
2. Roast zucchini 14-16 min.
3. Cook cavatappi 9-11 min; reserve 1.5 cup pasta water.
4. Cook onion 5-6 min; add sausage 3-4 min.
5. Add tomato paste+seasoning 1 min; add stock+pasta water; simmer.
6. Stir in pasta, zucchini, sour cream, butter; top with Parmesan.

title: Chicken Sausage & Sun-Dried Tomato Risotto
ingredients:
1 shallot
2 cloves garlic
4 oz grape tomatoes
1 zucchini
1.5 oz sun-dried tomatoes
1 tbsp Tuscan heat spice
3/4 cup arborio rice
2 veggie stock concentrate
4 oz cream sauce base
3 tbsp Parmesan
9 oz Italian chicken sausage mix
3 tsp cooking oil
1 tbsp butter
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Oven 450F. Boil 5 cups water, keep at simmer. Prep produce.
2. Roast zucchini+tomatoes 14-16 min. Brown sausage, remove.
3. Cook shallot 3-4 min; add rice, garlic, sun-dried tomatoes 1-2 min.
4. Add hot water+stock in stages, stirring, 25-30 min until al dente; stir in cream base+spice.
5. Off heat, stir in Parmesan+butter; fold in half the veg.
6. Plate risotto; top with veg, Parmesan, sausage.

title: Crispy Southwestern Chicken Cutlets
ingredients:
12 oz Yukon gold potatoes
1 yellow onion
1 poblano pepper
1/2 cup panko
1/4 cup Monterey Jack cheese
1 Southwest spice blend
1 tsp chili powder
12 oz chicken breasts
4 tbsp sour cream
1 tsp hot sauce
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tsp vegetable oil
2 tbsp butter
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Oven 425F. Boil diced potatoes 15-20 min; reserve 1/2 cup liquid.
2. Slice onion+poblano. Mix panko, cheese, spices, oil. Roast veg 5 min.
3. Brush chicken with sour cream; coat with panko mix.
4. Roast chicken on sheet 15-20 min.
5. Mash potatoes with butter, sour cream, cooking liquid.
6. Plate chicken+potatoes; top with roasted veg; serve with hot sauce.

title: One-Pan Santa Fe Pork Tacos
ingredients:
1 yellow onion
1/4 oz cilantro
1 lemon
10 oz ground pork
1 tbsp Southwest spice blend
4 oz shredded red cabbage
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 Tex-Mex paste
6 flour tortillas
1/4 cup Monterey Jack cheese
2 tbsp sour cream
1 tsp cooking oil
1 tsp sugar
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Dice onion; chop cilantro; quarter lemon.
2. Cook onion 2-3 min; add pork+Southwest spice until browned 4-6 min.
3. Slaw: cabbage, mayo, cilantro, lemon, sugar, salt.
4. Stir Tex-Mex paste into pork; warm tortillas; fill with pork, cheese, slaw, sour cream, cilantro.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry Tacos
ingredients:
10 oz chopped chicken breast
5 tsp rice wine vinegar
1 long green pepper
4 tbsp sweet soy glaze
2 tbsp mayonnaise
6 flour tortillas
1 crispy fried onions
4 oz coleslaw mix
1 tsp sriracha
1/4 oz cilantro
1 tsp cooking oil
1 tsp sugar
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Chop cilantro; slice green pepper. Slaw: coleslaw, vinegar, cilantro, sugar, salt.
2. Cook green pepper 2-3 min; add chicken until browned 4-6 min; add soy glaze, thicken.
3. Mix sriracha mayo; warm tortillas.
4. Fill tortillas with chicken and slaw; top with sriracha mayo, crispy onions, cilantro.

title: One-Pan Beef Stir-Fry Tacos
ingredients:
1/4 oz cilantro
4 oz shredded red cabbage
5 tsp rice wine vinegar
1 long green pepper
10 oz ground beef
4 tbsp sweet soy glaze
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tsp sriracha
6 flour tortillas
1 crispy fried onions
1.5 tsp sugar
1 tsp cooking oil
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Chop cilantro; slice green pepper. Slaw: cabbage, vinegar, cilantro, sugar, salt.
2. Cook green pepper 2-3 min; add beef until browned 4-6 min; add soy glaze+sugar.
3. Mix sriracha mayo; warm tortillas.
4. Fill tortillas with beef and slaw; top with sriracha mayo, crispy onions, cilantro.

title: Crispy Parmesan Chicken
ingredients:
12 oz chicken cutlets
6 oz green beans
1/2 cup Israeli couscous
1/4 cup panko
1/4 cup Parmesan
2 tbsp garlic herb butter
2 tbsp sour cream
1 lemon
1 tsp hot smoked paprika
2 scallions
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Oven 425F. Boil water; slice scallions.
2. Mix panko, Parmesan, paprika, oil; coat chicken with sour cream then panko.
3. Roast chicken + green beans 15-17 min.
4. Cook couscous 6-8 min; drain; toss with garlic butter+scallion whites.
5. Toss green beans with lemon.
6. Plate chicken, beans, couscous; top with scallion greens.

title: Sweet & Spicy Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients:
6 oz green beans
1 tbsp cornstarch
10 oz chopped chicken breast
1 oz sweet Thai chili sauce
1/2 cup jasmine rice
4 tbsp sweet soy glaze
1 lime
1 tsp garlic powder
1/4 oz cilantro
1 chili pepper
1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp cooking oil
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Cook rice 15-18 min.
2. Cut green beans; chop cilantro; quarter lime; slice chili.
3. Whisk cornstarch+water; add soy glaze+chili sauce. Season chicken with garlic powder.
4. Cook green beans 3-5 min, remove. Cook chicken 3-5 min.
5. Add sauce, simmer 1-2 min; stir in beans, cilantro, lime.
6. Serve over rice; add chili to taste.

title: Sweet Chili Chicken & Green Bean Stir-Fry
ingredients:
6 oz green beans
1 tbsp cornstarch
10 oz diced dark meat chicken
4 tbsp sweet soy glaze
1 oz sweet Thai chili sauce
1 microwavable rice packet
0.5 oz cashews
salt, pepper, oil, butter
steps:
1. Cut green beans; drain chicken; toss with cornstarch, salt, pepper.
2. Cook green beans + chicken 4-6 min; add water, soy glaze, chili sauce; simmer 1-2 min.
3. Heat rice; stir in butter; bowl rice+stir-fry; top with cashews.

title: Slow Cooker Beef, Carrot & Mushroom Stew
ingredients:
12 oz carrots
2 onions
4 oz cremini mushrooms
24 oz potatoes
1/4 oz parsley
5 tsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Worcestershire
2 tbsp soy sauce
3 beef stock concentrate
1 tomato paste
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp dried thyme
1 tsp paprika
1/2 cup flour
16 oz beef for braising
6 tbsp butter
steps:
1. Dice carrots, onions, potatoes; quarter mushrooms; chop parsley.
2. Make gravy: whisk vinegar, Worcestershire, soy, stock, tomato paste, spices, flour, water+butter; microwave to thicken.
3. Slow cooker: beef, carrots, onions, mushrooms + gravy; high 3.5 hrs.
4. Boil potatoes 15-20 min; reserve liquid.
5. Mash potatoes with butter+parsley.
6. Bowl mashed potatoes, top with stew, garnish parsley.

title: Meatloaves with Creamy Mushroom Sauce
ingredients:
10 oz ground beef
1/4 cup panko
2 scallions
1 tsp garlic powder
3 tbsp sour cream
12 oz potatoes
6 oz green beans
4 oz button mushrooms
1 beef stock concentrate
2 tbsp butter
1 tbsp cooking oil
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Boil potatoes 15-20 min; reserve 1/2 cup liquid.
2. Mix beef, panko, scallion whites, garlic powder, water; form 2 loaves.
3. Roast loaves 5 min; add green beans; roast 12-15 min.
4. Saute mushrooms; add stock+water; stir in sour cream+butter.
5. Mash potatoes with butter, sour cream, garlic powder, liquid.
6. Plate loaves, potatoes, beans; top with sauce, scallion greens.

title: BBQ Chicken Quesadillas
ingredients:
2 flour tortillas
4 tbsp BBQ sauce
4 tbsp sour cream
1 tsp ancho chili powder
1 jalapeno
1 fully cooked chicken breast
1 lime
1/2 cup Mexican cheese blend
1 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp sugar
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Slice jalapeno; zest+quarter lime; dice chicken.
2. Pickle jalapeno with lime+sugar+salt (microwave 30s); mix lime crema.
3. Cook chicken with chili powder 2-3 min; stir in BBQ sauce.
4. Cheese + chicken on tortilla halves; fold.
5. Cook quesadillas 3-4 min/side.
6. Quarter; serve with pickled jalapeno, crema, lime.

title: Creamy Turkey Bolognese
ingredients:
2 demi-baguettes
2 carrots
1 zucchini
1/4 oz parsley
9 oz cavatappi
1 tbsp Tuscan heat spice
20 oz ground turkey
6.75 oz milk
1 chicken stock concentrate
14 oz marinara
1 oz garlic herb butter
1.25 cup Parmesan
2 oz cream cheese
1 tsp chili flakes
4 tsp olive oil
salt & pepper
steps:
1. Oven 450F; prep produce; boil water.
2. Cook cavatappi 9-12 min; drain.
3. Saute carrots+zucchini 6-8 min.
4. Brown turkey; add milk+stock, reduce; return veg+marinara.
5. Toast baguettes with herb butter+Parmesan.
6. Stir cream cheese+pasta into turkey; serve with garlic bread.
